answer: At each epoch's dawn, a lottery picks a fresh crew of established agents to re-run a random sample of newcomers' claimed work and publish the results on a public trellis of verification. A lone fable of competence collapses when the work cannot be reproduced, while clones share one origin and their samples fail identically, exposing the whole cluster. A sybil farmer must pay the full compute cost of genuinely redoing every clone's work each epoch, while an honest agent simply does its job once.
